goal: Abort node startup with an explicit error if configured ZMQ notifications fail to bind or initialize
Prevent node operators from running with silently disabled notifications due to port collisions or bad configs
agreement: Substantive support for aborting on initialization failures (pinheadmz, jeanpablojp)
Verified by testing broken configs, permissioned ports, and port collisions (pinheadmz, jeanpablojp)
Open suggestion to simplify interface code and avoid an intermediate helper function (pinheadmz)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes silent notification failures caused by port collisions or invalid bind addresses
Alerts node operators at startup instead of burying bind errors in debug logs while running unaware
